svg.text: The FoldX channel — definitions and provenance

Everything behind tab Civ: how the number is computed, what the twelve terms are, and the exact two configurations. Encoder-independent — the channel is physics, reused unchanged across every backbone and every split.
per complex, serial, resumable — one cached JSON per complex
on the two SKEMPI chain groups
IE = interaction energy, kcal/mol. The same subtraction is taken term by term for the 12-vector.
Chain mapping is validated, not assumed
The dataset mutation carries a role chain (A/B = seq1/seq2); SKEMPI's Mutation(s)_cleaned carries the real PDB chain.
Matched on (wt_aa, pos, mut_aa), duplicates disambiguated role→group, every mapping checked against the repaired PDB.
Coverage — 87.7 % single-point, 98.7 % multi-point, 90.8 % combined. Uncovered rows fall back to the per-fold standardised mean (0).
each a ΔΔG in kcal/mol, mutant − wild-type · names as emitted by AnalyseComplex
Term 1 is the scalar Arm A uses, so Arm B strictly contains Arm A.
FoldX's Interaction Energy is a weighted sum of the components — the 12-vector is near-collinear by construction.
both write into the same add_scores slot; the regression head width is identical between them
MLP 12 → 16 → ReLU → Dropout → 1, trained jointly with the head
Measured on Ankh-large, S1102 CV10, 300 epochs / patience 30, paired folds.
Scalar is the safe default across the four SKEMPI benchmarks (+0.006–0.013); the MLP is the upside on ≥2k-mutation sets, and the arm that clears FoldX-alone on ESM-C 6B.
